scope: Independent review and correction of recovered worker mapping. Author approved the early design on 2026-09-11, conditional on empirical, observer and weight certification. No production target contract is activated here.
common_qualification: The 2005-06 ACS city sample uses 42 MET2013 codes, an explicitly approximate harmonized geography rather than the existing admitted-PUMA footprint. Its metro bootstrap is not an official ACS replicate-weight standard error.

records.sample: ACS household heads ages 18-85; occupied renter or owner; HHWT>0; 42 MET2013 cities; 2005-2006 pooled by summed HHWT numerator/denominator; inherits all common_acs_sample filters
records.geography: 42 MET2013 city codes; not admitted-PUMA footprint
records.model_formula: Current extract_moments: aggregate_housing_demand/total_mass, all 17 age cells, uncapped. Proposed: weighted_mean(min(s,9)) on full g, observed at pre-announcement stationary solution.
records.adjustment: Use g_current and full hR_pol before income collapse; cap each renter/owner observation, then aggregate. All 17 current four-year age cells already span 18-85: validate geometry rather than invent an extra age restriction.
records.mismatch: Existing HistoricalMomentObserver is pinned to 2023 and old 12 rows. min(E[s|collapsed income],9) does not equal E[min(s,9)|income]; compute direct. The initial window and geographic approximation must be retained.

records.sample: ACS heads ages 30-55; DUE structures UNITSSTR 3:10; HHWT>0; 42 MET2013 cities; 2005-2006; inherits all common_acs_sample filters
records.adjustment: Use owner indicator on full realized distribution with declared 30-55 age-exposure selector; pin the maintained DUE-to-model-product interpretation.
records.mismatch: Current nearest-index mask includes full 54-57 cell; no structure-type state allows exact UNITSSTR filtering. Neither issue is resolved by changing the row name.

records.sample: ACS heads ages 30-55; recent parent NCHILD>0 and ELDCH<4 minus NCHILD=0 controls; 42 MET2013 cities; 2005-2006; inherits all common_acs_sample filters; both groups also require UNITSSTR in 3:10
records.model_formula: Under independent_count: Pr(owner | n>=1,m>0, current prime mask) - Pr(owner | n=0,childless readiness states,current prime mask). newparent_cs includes ALL positive dependent counts, with no recency condition.
records.adjustment: Exact ACS recent-parent group and resident-child controls cannot be recovered from current count-only states. Do not substitute n=0 controls or all m>0 parents without an explicitly approved proxy contract; retain identifying row as blocked rather than silently dropping it.
records.mismatch: ELDCH is OLDEST resident own child: all resident own children must be under four. Model has no child ages or time since birth; independent binomial maturation has mean 18 years but no deterministic under-18 cutoff. ACS NCHILD=0 includes former parents with no own child resident, whereas model control is lifetime n=0. Adding m=0 controls would still conflate absent dependents with absent resident adult children.

records.sample: ACS heads ages 30-55, YNGCH<18; NCHILD>=3 minus NCHILD=1-2; 42 MET2013 cities; 2005-2006; inherits all common_acs_sample filters
records.model_formula: Current child_bin_high_cutoff=3 and independent_count use m=cs, subject to cs<=n: high group m>=3; low group 1<=m<=2. Existing moment is uncapped and uses current prime age mask. Proposed proxy: E[min(s,9)|m>=3]-E[min(s,9)|1<=m<=2], with declared age selector.
records.adjustment: Cap full income-resolved renter and owner rooms before any collapse. Runtime-assert child_state_mode=independent_count and child_bin_high_cutoff=3. Need explicit resident-child approximation or richer observation information before SMM certification.
records.mismatch: ACS NCHILD counts ALL resident own children while YNGCH<18 requires at least one minor. Example: ages 4,19,21 is empirical large family but may be one model dependent. m has no deterministic child-age bound under binomial maturation. Verifying independent_count is necessary but insufficient for exact ACS group equivalence.

records.sample: PSID reference persons ages 18-85, relation_to_head=10, positive IW, finite NETWORTHR; working-age gross earnings required/nonnegative; 2003-2005; actual selected waves 2003 and 2005; 10,828 family-years/6,018 IDs in wealth, 9,265 family-years/5,215 IDs in earnings.
records.date: PSID survey waves 2003 and 2005, not an audited same-calendar stock/flow date
records.model_formula: sum_x g_asset(x)*(b+1_owner*p*H) / sum_{j<J_R} g_asset(x)*[P.income(i,j)*z/((1-tau_pay)*4)]. All living 18-85 wealth cells; 12 working cells cover 18-65. P.income is already a four-year flow after payroll tax.
records.adjustment: Observe the pre-announcement stationary state using coherent beginning-period g_asset; use actual pension-consistent parameters. Gross earnings formula and 18-65 cell coverage match the intended earnings concept; no automatic 2023 reuse.
records.mismatch: RP/spouse household earnings is the intended labor-income concept. Missing within-wave wealth valuation versus earnings reference-year metadata remains a calendar certification limit; national household income normalization and selection on finite outcomes are maintained approximations.

records.sample: Living PSID reference persons ages 76-84, relation_to_head=10, positive IW, completed children observed, INCFAMR>1000; p90/p50 of NETWORTHR/INCFAMR; 2003-2005; 644 valid family-years/416 IDs; bootstrap population 918 living reference IDs ages 65-84, before outcome/children filters.
records.model_formula: Weighted p90/p50 of W/annual_gross_income_at_state using g_asset; annualization divides P income by 4, payroll gross-up only for workers. Existing old mask selects labels 78 and 82. Existing quantile algorithm matches R; no transaction wedge is subtracted from W.
records.adjustment: Pin annual-age selection for 76-84; confirm household income mapping and empirical $1000 real-income cutoff in normalized model units. Observe initial stationary state, not 2023. Model quantile is available but sample/income equality is not established.
records.mismatch: At these retirement ages model denominator is pension income (including configured z scaling), while PSID INCFAMR also includes transfers, asset income and other family components. Exact $1000 cutoff is not applied (only income>0), and observed-completed-children selection has no model missingness counterpart. Full 78/82 cells do not cover exactly 76-84.

records.model_formula: [sum_x (1-survival_j)*g_current(x)*max(bp_pol(x)+1_owner*p*H,0)/4] / sum_x g_asset(x)*(b+1_owner*p*H). Terminal death probability forced to 1; earlier death probabilities from survival. Debt/transaction timing must remain coherent.
records.adjustment: Keep explicitly external or replace only with a separately identified bequest-block decision and Jacobian check.
records.mismatch: Borrowed historical annual aggregate flow is imperfectly matched to model mortality, nonnegative estates and forced terminal deaths; no initial PSID sample or empirical SE. Gale-Scholz/De Nardi-Yang provenance is inherited, not freshly reviewed literature.

records.model_formula: Select successful first births from initial g_pre; clone identical pre-birth states into treated n=1,m=1 and childless control. Advance both one period with origin policies/survival/income/maturation, then realize destination housing with destination policies. Treated may have continuation birth; control stays childless. Difference of destination uncapped rooms equals matched difference in changes.
records.adjustment: For an initial stationary observer call begin_dated_first_birth_housing_branch then finish_dated_first_birth_housing_branch with the stationary policy as BOTH dates; retain destination continuation births and no Census age bridge. Do NOT use first_birth_housing_response sequential legacy helper, which suppresses continuation births. Certify the same paired branch with mass/timing checks.
records.mismatch: Applying the unchanged pooled contrast to initial stationary economy requires approved stability approximation. Model matched-risk weights differ from estimator cohort/event weights. Non-flat prepath and normalization dependence remain disclosed; September5 normalization check changed point to .730459 with identical fitted values, not a replacement target. Four-year approximation is not literal observed -1/+3 child ages. Keep PSID rooms uncapped; do not import ACS cap.

notation.g: Full income-resolved living distribution after current housing/tenure choices; state x=(b,tenure,location,age,income,parity,dependent_count).
notation.g_asset: Beginning-period balance-sheet distribution before housing transactions; dated adapter supplies evaluation.g_post_fertility.
notation.s: Realized occupied rooms: renter hR_pol at the actual income state, or owner H_own at the chosen product.
notation.W: Beginning-period total household net worth b+p*H_own for owners and b for renters; b is net financial wealth.
notation.age_cells: 17 four-year cells labeled 18,22,...,82; interval interpretation is ages label through label+3.
notation.weighted_mean: sum(g * sample_selector * value)/sum(g * sample_selector); refuse an empty selected group.
notation.weighted_quantile: Smallest observed value whose cumulative positive weight reaches the requested fraction; identical algorithm in R builder and model utils.

common_acs_sample.filters: sample=year*100+1; GQ in {1,2}; PERNUM=1; RELATE=1; HHWT>0; 18<=AGE<=85; OWNERSHP in {1,2}; ROOMS>0; MET2013 in pinned 42-code list
common_acs_sample.rooms: min(ROOMS,9) before any aggregation; pooled household-weighted numerators/denominators, not average yearly ratios
common_acs_sample.structures: UNITSSTR in 3:10 for all ownership rows, including both recent-parent comparison groups; no structure restriction for rooms rows
common_acs_sample.geography: Direct MET2013 membership in 42 cities; NOT old admitted-PUMA footprint. National fertility/PSID plus metro housing is an explicitly maintained geographic approximation.
common_acs_sample.uncertainty: 1000 paired metro-resampling draws, seed 20260910, 42 clusters. Not ACS official survey-design or replicate-weight standard errors.
common_acs_sample.weights_status: Inverse marginal variance values below are candidate diagonal weights under the approved design, not a promoted target/weight fingerprint.
